scope: November 2020 domestic protest, assembly, strikes, and sector/regional coverage
known_limit: Eight managed web queries covered weekly November windows, English and Tigrinya, official MOI and diaspora outlets. Search results included older protest reporting, generic material, and reports of armed rocket attacks in the Ethiopia-Tigray conflict; these do not establish civil public gatherings in Eritrea. No exact article body was opened. Search-result snippets alone are not proof of absence.
next_steps: Search independent reporting for Asmara, Keren, Massawa, Assab, Barentu, Mendefera, Anseba, Gash-Barka and Red Sea regions; workers, teachers, students, women, retirees, religious communities and national-service-related issues; assess any exact source before requesting its body.
